notes: Editor timings are exploratory, not evidence of a stable latency improvement; only request counts are compared.
CPU throttling is emulation on one machine, not a real low-end device.
Table timings include sorting and server rendering, not browser input latency.
Windows power plan: Power saver; no system power settings changed.

frameBudget.notes: CPU throttling is emulation; 3 s warmed samples; before 3 repeats, after inputs/borders/quantum 2, media 3. rendererFrames counts only main-thread WebGL/Canvas2D draws, not OffscreenCanvas workers. CPU fallback diagnostic uses updated scheduler before the GPU-only cap change. A discarded intermediate 3-repeat run timed out waiting for 90 border canvases; subsequent 2-repeat run completed.

melodyRoll.notesOnMethod: Two warmed 3 s samples per CPU rate, after then verified baseline. Baseline replaces only MelodyRoll TSX/CSS (asserted two files), shared scheduler unchanged. rendererFrames is React commit count for this scenario. Initial baseline and unverified replay excluded.

melodyWorker.measurement: Main-thread requestAnimationFrame intervals and React commits, not physical GPU presentations. CPU throttling is emulation on one host. Stable 60 FPS not achieved.

visualComparisons.scenario: blue theme, hit, width 800 height 240, DPR 2

melodyWorker.visualLimitations: Settled screenshots; infinite key animations paused at time zero for comparison. Mean values use the whole image, including empty background. Canvas/CSS antialiasing differs. Screenshots do not prove equality of every intermediate animation frame or custom CSS.

melodyMainThreadInvestigation.outcome: All production experiments from this investigation reverted. No reproducible frame-rate improvement established; stable 60 FPS not achieved. Existing work from the previous iteration preserved.

trace.warning: Nested trace event durations overlap; do not sum them or compare traced FPS directly with untraced samples.

visual.scope: Settled trail with silence gap. Does not validate every intermediate animation frame.

melodyMainThreadInvestigation.benchmarkChange: Wait explicitly for worker readiness before the existing 1200 ms warmup. FRAME_PAUSE_GLOW is diagnostic only. FRAME_MELODY_REFERENCE loads and validates three saved source files.

melodyForegroundWorker.description: Notes, text, key effects and seconds grid in the existing worker; controlled playback still updates through React.

webfont.extraCss: Bundled MelodixText-600.woff2 loaded as MeasureFont; font-weight:100 900

checks.fullCheck: TypeScript, both production builds, 620 tests / 41 files passed
checks.afterErrorHandling: 16 MediaContracts, node --check for worker and benchmark, UI library build passed

limitations: Main-thread rAF is not physical GPU presentation FPS
CPU throttling targets page thread, not all worker/GPU hardware
Worker cadence near 60 FPS does not remove delayed position updates from React
Canvas and CSS antialiasing differ; screenshots are not pixel-identical
Stable 60 FPS for the complete scene is not established
